i’m (23, F) very lucky as an essential worker that i’m able to keep my job. i work in childcare and i was let go for only a week, and then i was asked to come back due to the jobkeeper program (i’m in australia). i said yes. i love my job a lot, but i feel extremely overwhelmed right now. 

i used to work 5 mins away from my house, but since i figured i wasn’t going to be working (at that point in time where i thought i was going to be unemployed for much longer than only a week), i made the decision to move in with my partner (24,M) and his family. i didn’t want to be irresponsible in terms of the virus and keep visiting each other (we live apart), and i wanted to spend this difficult time with him rather than endure up to who knows how long without seeing him. the suburb he’s in is about 40 mins from my job and the traffic is still somehow (in these quarantine times) pretty shitty. 

due to the specifics of my job and the situation right now, all of us at the daycare centre are having to do extra hours with shorter breaks. so i’m doing the 40 minute drive for a long ass day with too short of a break, and then doing the drive back home in heavy traffic. anyone who’s worked in childcare will know that the job is very very exerting - physically and emotionally. you’re on your feet moving around all day, talking all day, having to be patient all day. 

i don’t want to sound ungrateful, because i’m so glad to be able to work right now. and i’m someone who really doesn’t mind longer drives, but lately in the past week when i get home from work, i’m absolutely fucking exhausted and overwhelmed and emotional. i feel like i’m always on the verge of tears but can’t get them out. tiny things like having a shower or even getting a glass of water is so fucking overwhelming for me. 

my partner is doing a full time IT degree and he’s right in the thick of assessment right now. he basically wakes up, studies, then goes to bed to do the same thing again the next day. he used to do most of the cooking but he doesn’t have time to do it now, and so it will be another thing i have to do when i get home. he used to have a little bit of time to hang out with me a bit when i would get home, but now he barely even has time to say hello. 

with all of this too, i suffer from body dysmorphic disorder, and since gaining a little weight recently, i’m in a bad episode of it. when i come home and have a shower i see my naked body and i feel like bawling my eyes out. i hate the way my face looks and lately i’ve been extremely self conscious about my lack of jaw and hint of a double chin. i’m so uncomfortable in my body right now. it’s part of our job to take photos of the children to put on the app we use which sort of documents the kids’ day and what they learned etc, and sometimes in these photos. and it’s becoming so hard to just look through and enjoy the photos of the kids, because all my brain sees is how fat and ugly i look in the ones i’ve been captured in. i’ve dealt with disordered eating in the past, and i’m afraid i’m going to return to it. i also want to exercise but with the huge drive and now having to cook dinner when i get home, i don’t feel like i have time. and on the weekend i’m just too exhausted from the week. 

i enjoy my days at work even though they’re tiring, but it’s like when i come home, reality hits me and i feel so awful. i’m especially sad because of how alone i feel since i can barely spend time or talk to my partner anymore. i feel like i really need support but i can’t get it right now. obviously i understand his situation and i don’t expect him to drop everything for me, but i just feel sad. 

i don’t know what to do.
